messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-89234 fired: GPU memory pressure detected in pool 'gpu-pool-us-west2-4' at 2026-03-14T02:15:34Z. Symptoms: repeated CUDA OOMs and kernel alloc failures.

incident-bot: Summary: multiple inference-worker pods on node gpu-4-12 reporting OOMs; eviction spikes; tail latency increasing.

maria (oncall): Ack'd. I'm looking.

devon (sre): I'm seeing high eviction counts on gpu-4-12, memory accounting stuck around 98% for ~6m. Fetching pod logs now.

kyle (eng): Noted. Can we flip routing to fallback model gpt-13b-quant and reduce batch size while we mitigate? I can push a temporary policy.

pagerduty-bot: devon (sre) acknowledged PD-89234 (ack at 02:16:10Z).

maria (oncall): `kubectl describe node gpu-4-12` shows sustained GPU mem usage and repeated kernel OOM lines. Beginning cordon+drain to take node out of rotation.

maria (oncall): Running commands:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-4-12
kubectl drain gpu-4-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

devon (sre): While drain runs, I'm enabling auto-shedder for the public /v1/chat route (max_tokens -> 512) and updating model routing to send 80% traffic to fallback in us-west2.

kyle (eng): Pushed routing override: route /v1/chat -> gpt-13b-quant (80%) / gpt-13b (20%) for us-west2. Also lowered batch_size from 16 -> 8 for the fallback route.

ops-runner: Requested scale: autoscaler +2 nodes to gpu-pool-us-west2-4 (provisioning).

maria (oncall): Pods scheduled onto other nodes, restarted inference workers there. Observed immediate drop in CUDA OOM logs in the last 90s. Median latency for affected endpoints dropped from ~1.8s -> ~450ms.

devon (sre): Metrics: error rate (5m) before mitigation 4.2% -> after 0.7%. Queue length and request backlog returning to baseline.

customer-impact-bot: Affected customers: org-87 (chat), org-240 (rerank). Impact window ~02:14Z-02:20Z. Estimated ~1.1% of global requests affected in that interval.

maria (oncall): I reached out to SEs for org-87 and org-240 to give a heads-up. No P1 escalations opened by customers so far.

sre-lead: Good call on routing and scale. Keep the pool scaled for 15m, monitor for recurrence. @devon please collect kernel logs, nv_driver traces, and GPU telemetry for postmortem.

devon (sre): Grabbing logs now:
```
journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -n 500 --no-pager > /tmp/PD-89234-nvid.log
grep -i "cuda" /var/log/kern.log | tail -n 200 > /tmp/PD-89234-kern.log
```

maria (oncall): I'll hand off in ~30m to @kyle for overnight coverage. Leaving the routing override and extra nodes active for now.

pagerduty-bot: PD-89234 marked acknowledged and mitigated at 02:23:04Z. :white_check_mark:

maria (oncall): Marking thread resolved for now. I'll create an incident ticket with timeline and remediation actions and open a postmortem. Suggestion: consider pinning driver version and reviewing per-pod GPU mem limits.

kyle (eng): Please include recommendation: lower auto-eviction threshold from 95% -> 92% and tighten per-pod memory requests/limits for large models. Also consider fallback model autoswitching sooner.

devon (sre): Uploaded collected logs to internal store: https://internal.redwood/PD-89234/logs (artifacts: /mnt/incidents/PD-89234/logs). Will attach nv_driver traces and metrics.

maria (oncall): Final note: small chance of recurrence until we validate driver/firmware variants. I'll keep an eye on alerts and metrics. Thanks team. :eyes:
